/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/jannat-ke-sardaar.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
metadata, roman_and_source = original.split(b'romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, source = roman_and_source.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)
lyrics = roman.decode()
for old, new in (
    ('Tehrir Muhammad', 'Tahrir Muhammad'),
    ('jaayega', 'jaaye ga'),
    ('Karbobala', 'Karb o Bala'),
    ('haiṅ maiṅ in ka', 'haiṅ main in ka'),
    ('qaayam ka', 'qiyaam ka'),
):
    assert lyrics.count(old) == 1
    lyrics = lyrics.replace(old, new)
updated = metadata + b'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + lyrics.encode() + b'\\n---\\n' + source
path.write_bytes(updated)
written = path.read_bytes()
assert written.startswith(metadata)
assert written.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == source
roman_lines = lyrics.splitlines()
source_lines = source.decode().splitlines()
assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines)
for roman_line, source_line in zip(roman_lines, source_lines, strict=True):
    assert bool(roman_line.strip()) == bool(source_line.strip())
    if source_line.isdecimal():
        assert roman_line.strip() == str(int(source_line))
assert all(ch.isascii() or ch in 'ṅṄ' for ch in lyrics)
print(sum(bool(line) and not line.isdecimal() for line in source_lines), 'verse pairs')
PY"
